display_name: Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 (UK) under one top-level goal — notice of seizure, the claim deadline and condemnation (Schedule 3), fraudulent evasion under s 170 with its maximum penalties (Schedule 1), and the s 146A time limits — and those three goals

others: notice of seizure must be given for (cema-forfeiture.l4)
the last day for a notice of claim for (cema-forfeiture.l4)
an offence under s 170 is made out by (cema-penalties.l4)
the maximum penalties under s 170 for (cema-penalties.l4)
the last day to commence proceedings for (cema-time-limits.l4)

scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 139(6), 146A(2)-(3), 149(1), 170(1)-(5), Schedule 1 and Schedule 3 paras 1-6 of the revised text as at 29 April 2026. Inputs: seizure and claim dates and facts, kind and value of goods, the summary fixed sum, offence and evidence dates. Left out on purpose: everything else (administration, procedure, other offences, Schedules 2 and 4-7).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 90 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); none failed. Dates are computed as the Act words them, with no working-day rule. The pipeline has not been run.
